quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady explains why he won't attend Jay-Z's Super Bowl show
quotes.excerpt: It's over. For me, at least.
quotes.quote: I'm not going to see Hov, bro. I'm not. I listen, Hov is my guy. You know this. I just went and seen him in Yankee Stadium. I don't want to see him again. It's over. It's over. For me, at least.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter's prediction for Jay-Z's Super Bowl performance style
quotes.excerpt: I think you're going to get classics that's done well, but they're going to be a little more commercial.
quotes.quote: I think some people are going to get caught into, when we think of Hov and then you put yourself into concert mode, and that's not what this is going to be. Because of who he is, what he -- I mean, we already know his playlist is years long, and he can go any direction. I think you're going to get classics that's done well, but they're going to be a little more commercial. And then if he does go kind of to that B-side, to that, you know, the Hov we all know and love, it's going to be a version of what we've heard. I mean, I just think he's just giving us one more.
